newsitem.title: USA: Central and South West reaches settlement.
newsitem.headline: Central and South West reaches settlement.

text.p: Central and South West Corp said Wednesday that it has a settlement agreement with El Paso Electric Co to resolve pending litigation stemming from the June 1995 termination of their proposed merger.
As a result of the settlement, Central and South West said it will pay $35 million to El Paso, various of its creditor groups under El Paso's reorganization plan and its attorneys.

In the first quarter of 1997, Central and South West recorded a charge to earnings for the $25 million obligation to El Paso. The company said it would recognize the additional $10 million when it reports results for the second quarter of 1997.

Under terms of the settlement, the two companies have agreed to dismiss all pending claims in the litigation and to give a mutual release from any potential claims related to the terminated merger agreement or the pending litigation.
